observations.statement: OBSERVED (third-party): fee $20/document; form DS-4194; check/money order payable to 'U.S. Department of State'; prepaid return envelope; country of use in Section 4.
OBSERVED (third-party): mail to Office of Authentications, U.S. Department of State, 44132 Mercure Circle, PO Box 1206, Sterling, VA 20166-1206.
OBSERVED (22 CFR 5.3 via casetext): walk-in 600 19th St NW, Washington DC 20006.
OBSERVED (single third-party): counter open 8am-3pm Mon-Fri; walk-ins 8-9am Mon-Thu; appointments 10:30am-2:30pm Mon-Thu; no counter service Friday.

OBSERVED (third-party, disagreeing): mail 'within five weeks' vs '6-8+ weeks'; walk-in 7 business days vs 7-9 days; same-day only for documented life-or-death emergency with advance approval. Handbook must show a range with as-of date, never a point estimate.
